decisions.reason: The manual laser workstation line extends the firm's core laser offer and has stayed visible for two years, so it likely meets aspirations at low incremental cost.
The thermal inkjet printer sits close to the established offer and kept its own page in both years, which suggests satisfactory results that call for no problemistic search.
The piezo inkjet printer complements the high-resolution portfolio and the single-source strategy, and its continued dedicated presentation indicates stable performance.
As the flagship laser line shown on the home page, it is central to the firm's direction and will be supported even if early results are still uncertain.
The newly launched compact laser cabin fits the laser focus, and a large firm's slack allows it to carry the product while results develop.
The lubricant printing system serves a narrower niche with only a brief website mention, but it is new and uses existing competences, so slack lets the firm keep it for now.
